definition.name: Same-component Go entropy explicit authority and retirement

steps.name: Install only existing locked Python dependencies
Check exact-source replay and finite entropy authority controls
Read fixed original public documents and binary products
Re-sign unchanged component and repeat all original and entropy outcomes
Retain bounded same-component source and signed observations

with.name: go-entropy-authority-replay-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/go-entropy-original-inputs/acquisition.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-entropy-original-inputs/acquisition-failure.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-entropy-authority-replay/qualification.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-entropy-authority-replay/FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-entropy-authority-replay/node/workflow.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-entropy-authority-replay/node/FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-entropy-authority-replay/node/controls/*.json

reviewReason: Bounded fixed-index artifact replay preserves byte/file caps; closed setup guard/counters replace opaque failure, no runtime or acceptance ceiling changes.
